# Meteor Dodge

A simple HTML canvas game where the player controls a ship that moves left and right at the bottom of the screen to dodge falling meteors. Meteors spawn from random positions at the top and fall with increasing speed. The player earns points for each meteor avoided. The game ends (lose condition) when a meteor collides with the ship.
